public=公开域名，永久有效；presigned=签名链接，到期失效: public = public domain, never expires; presigned = signed link, expires
七牛 S3 网关用虚拟主机式寻址，填 false: Qiniu's S3 gateway uses virtual-hosted-style addressing — set this to false
上一页返回的 marker；空=从头: The marker returned by the previous page; blank = from the beginning
仅签名链接用；公开域名链接忽略它: Only used for signed links; public-domain links ignore this
列一次对象（最多 1 条）验证密钥、桶名与区域是否配对: Lists one object (at most 1) to verify the key, bucket, and region match
取对象的可直接访问链接：公开域名（永久）或签名链接（限时）；都不支持则报错，平台: Gets a directly accessible link for an object: public domain (permanent) or signed link (time-limited); errors if neither is supported, and the platform falls back to proxied download
只有新区域尚未支持、或你走了自建代理时才需要填；填了以填的为准: Only needed when a new region isn't supported yet, or you're using a self-built proxy; if filled in, it takes precedence
在空间概览页查看。S3 兼容域名按它自动推出（s3.<区域>.qiniucs.c: Found on the space overview page. The S3-compatible endpoint is derived from it automatically (s3.<region>.qiniucs.com), so you usually don't need to fill in the field below
填了才有永久公开链接；留空只能签发限时链接。它与上面的 S3 域名不是一回事: A permanent public link exists only if this is filled in; otherwise only time-limited links can be issued. This is not the same as the S3 endpoint above
平台文件引用；字节由插件经文件通道拉取: Platform file reference; the plugin fetches the bytes via the file channel
把一个平台文件写进桶；同 key 覆盖: Writes a platform file into the bucket; overwrites on the same key
把桶里的对象取回为平台文件引用: Retrieves an object from the bucket as a platform file reference
按 key 批量删除；已不存在的视为成功（幂等）: Batch deletes by key; objects that no longer exist are treated as success (idempotent)
按前缀列出桶内对象；marker 翻页（对账靠它扫全桶）: Lists objects in the bucket by prefix; paginated via marker (reconciliation scans the whole bucket using it)
查单个对象的大小/类型/ETag；不存在时 exists=false（不是报错）: Looks up a single object's size/type/ETag; exists=false if it doesn't exist (not an error)
空=取 key 的最后一段: Blank = uses the last segment of the key
走七牛的 S3 兼容网关，与「S3 兼容对象存储」是同一份实现。: Goes through Qiniu's S3-compatible gateway and shares the same implementation as "S3-compatible object storage".
